clips.title: The story
paras: Maybell Maclure waits for a way to slip away from her family and meet Tommy Joe Stonefield. You bring her William Pestle's Invisibility Liquor, brewed from crystal kelp gathered across the region.

The Maclures and Stonefields have feuded for generations, leaving no room for courtship. Gramma Stonefield turns to William Pestle, an alchemist in the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. With crystal kelp from nearby lakes, Pestle brews Invisibility Liquor strong enough to hide Maybell's escape from the Maclure homestead.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this invisibility liquor to young Maybell. It should last long enough for her to visit Tommy Joe.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe? What did he say??

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh...my! I feel guilty deceiving my family, but my feelings for Tommy Joe are too strong to ignore.
Thank you, friend. I'll drink this liquor as soon as I have the chance and sneak away to my love.
And for you... Please take this.
